<details>
<summary>Text description of this diagram</summary>

**Two gates in series, and both have to be yes.**

**First: did you collect, manipulate or interpret data to answer a question?**

**Second: is somebody going to act on the answer?**

**If both are yes, the playbook applies to it.** If either is no, it does not.

**The test is the definition, not the list of examples.** All of these pass it: a dataset created for a Freedom of Information request; an answer to a
Parliamentary Question; a sponsor's request for data to inform a policy decision; an official
statistics report; a dashboard for commissioners; a complex forecasting model informing budgets. So does a one-off number somebody is about to quote
in a meeting. Used internally, supplied to sponsors, or published externally: all of it is in scope.

**What changes between them is how much assurance each one needs**, and that is
[deciding your assurance level](/guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd).

</details>
